visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a ponytail, wearing a dark blue long-sleeved athletic shirt and bright yellow baseball pants with a red belt, stands inside an indoor practice facility. She stands on a black mat in front of green netting and performs a focused left-handed pitching motion toward the camera. A red and white ball bag sits prominently on her right. (2) The scene cuts to a large indoor baseball stadium with a red dirt infield and green turf. A male player in a navy blue jersey and a blue batting helmet holds a bat in a bunting stance, successfully making contact with a ball. Cameras and spectators are visible in the background seating area. (3) A different male player in a navy jersey and helmet swings a wooden bat at a pitch on the same stadium field. The camera follows the ball as it travels across the infield. (4) A male player wearing a yellow baseball cap and a navy blue jersey crouches on the green turf, fielding a ground ball with his glove. He maintains a concentrated expression as he gathers the ball and prepares to throw.

Faint echoes of a large indoor stadium and distant male voices calling out 'Good!' in Mandarin provide ambient texture while the music continues at a steady volume. The background music concludes with a final drum hit as the clip ends, with the overall audio being very clean and focused on the training sounds.
